summary: Tested Lead Flows Library end-to-end. Backend API regression (10/10 pass) + frontend UI: library, editor (tabs, save, validation, summary), duplicate/delete, picker attach/detach, flow-wins hidden fields on lead source. Ladder/exhaustion e2e was intentionally skipped (already 22/22 by main agent). One functional bug found: 'Start from a blank flow' returns 400 from backend.

critical.issue: Frontend 'Start from a blank flow' posts {name:'New flow'} which the backend rejects with 400 'Text + Call needs at least one attempt with a rep on it' because clean_flow defaults contact_mode='text_and_call' with no attempts. Blank template path is unusable.

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping 'Start from a blank flow' surfaces backend 400 error toast instead of creating an empty flow. Same underlying cause as backend bug above; frontend should either send contact_mode='text_only' when creating blank, or backend clean_flow should default to text_only for blank body.

action_items: Fix blank-flow creation: either send template_key/contact_mode='text_only' from /app/frontend/app/lead-flows/index.tsx createFromTemplate(null), or make backend services/lead_flows.clean_flow default to contact_mode='text_only' when no attempts and no template are provided.
critical_code_review_comments: services/lead_flows.clean_flow forces contact_mode='text_and_call' when unset, so any create without a template_key and without call_attempts fails validation - this makes the frontend 'blank flow' button impossible to use.
routers/lead_flows.require_manager uses request.state.user which is fine, but consider caching to avoid re-fetching user on every request in same call chain.
Frontend index.tsx line 43: api.post('/lead-flows', {name:'New flow'}) doesn't set a contact_mode; should be {name:'New flow', contact_mode:'text_only'} to avoid backend validation error.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (blank-flow entry point broken; all other flows verified)

rca of the issue: Blank-flow 400: /app/frontend/app/lead-flows/index.tsx line 43 sends `{name:'New flow'}` when no template_key. In /app/backend/services/lead_flows.py clean_flow() sets `base['contact_mode']='text_and_call'` if not one of the two valid values. Then routers/lead_flows._validate raises 400 because contact_mode=='text_and_call' and normalize_flow_attempts([]) is empty. Fix: either send `contact_mode:'text_only'` from the blank path in the frontend, OR in clean_flow default to 'text_only' when the incoming body has no call_attempts and existing has none. The latter also protects any other blank creation path.
